# Zachary Holcombe D.M.D. General Dentistry

> Small, family-owned general dental practice in Asheville, North Carolina, led by Dr. Zachary S. Holcombe, DMD. We provide preventive care, children's dentistry, crowns and bridges, cosmetic and emergency dentistry, implant restorations, dentures, root canals, extractions, gum disease treatment, and TMJ treatment and night guards for patients of all ages.

- Practice: Zachary Holcombe D.M.D. General Dentistry
- Dentist: Dr. Zachary S. Holcombe, DMD (East Carolina University; undergraduate at North Carolina State University). Took over the practice in 2018.
- Memberships: American Dental Association, Academy of General Dentistry, North Carolina Dental Society, Buncombe County Dental Society
- Address: 1944 Hendersonville Rd., Suite B-2, Asheville, NC 28803
- Previous dentist: Dr. Glenn Miller, DDS (Dr. Holcombe took ownership in 2018)
- Phone: 828-684-3839
- Email: office@dentalasheville.com
- Hours: Monday–Thursday 8:00am–5:00pm; Friday–Sunday closed
- Patients: families, children to senior adults; new patients and emergency patients welcome
- Scheduling: call the office or request an appointment online at https://zacharysholcombe.com/contact.html
- New patient special: $225 adult comprehensive exam; the first visit includes an exam, X-rays and a cleaning
- Insurance: files all dental insurance; out-of-network with all plans
- Financing: CareCredit and Cherry
- What sets the practice apart: small, private, family-owned; same dentist every visit; long-term patient relationships; comfortable atmosphere
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dentalasheville/

## Services

- [Diagnostic & Preventative Care](https://zacharysholcombe.com/preventive-care.html): Regular exams, X-rays and professional cleanings to keep your teeth healthy and stop gum disease before it starts.
- [Children’s Dentistry](https://zacharysholcombe.com/childrens-dentistry.html): Gentle checkups, cleanings, fluoride and sealants that help kids build healthy habits for life.
- [Crowns, Bridges & Fillings](https://zacharysholcombe.com/crowns-bridges.html): Natural-looking crowns, bridges and tooth-colored fillings that restore strength and function.
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://zacharysholcombe.com/cosmetic-dentistry.html): Teeth whitening, veneers and tooth-colored restorations to help you smile with confidence.
- [Emergency Dentistry](https://zacharysholcombe.com/emergency-dentistry.html): Toothache, broken tooth or lost crown? Call us and we’ll see you as quickly as possible.
- [Implant Restorations](https://zacharysholcombe.com/dental-implants.html): Implant crowns, bridges, snap-in dentures and fixed hybrids to replace missing teeth.
- [Complete & Partial Dentures](https://zacharysholcombe.com/dentures.html): Complete and partial dentures, including implant-supported options, so you can chew and smile again.
- [Root Canals](https://zacharysholcombe.com/root-canals.html): Relieve tooth pain, remove infection and save your natural tooth.
- [Tooth Extractions](https://zacharysholcombe.com/oral-surgery.html): Gentle tooth extractions, surgical root tip extractions and alveoloplasty.
- [Gum Disease Treatment](https://zacharysholcombe.com/periodontics.html): Scaling and root planing and other periodontal treatments to protect your gums and bone.
- [TMJ Treatment & Night Guards](https://zacharysholcombe.com/tmj-night-guards.html): Relief for jaw pain and custom night guards that protect your teeth from grinding.
